title: Guided level-up flow backed by the rules pack
description: Orchestrated, guided level-up flow analogous to the guided character setup (characterWizard.ts / playCharacter flow): walk the player through eligibility, required choices, and confirmation, driven entirely by the deterministic engine and required-choices model — narration optional, mechanics never LLM-improvised. Commits the level-up via the auditable apply path.
acceptance_criteria: A guided flow validates eligibility, collects required choices, previews the deterministic change set, and commits it; unsupported choices halt the flow with explicit messaging; flow is covered by orchestration tests.
close_reason: Implemented core guided level-up orchestration with eligibility, required-choice collection, preview, confirmation, commit, and unsupported-choice blocking.
